verified_facts.text: The resort sits on the beach at Nusa Dua.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set along the golden sands of Nusa Dua, The St. Regis Bali Resort offers an exceptional collection of spacious suites, villas, and residences

verified_facts.text: The resort is right on the beach in Nusa Dua, Bali.
verified_facts.excerpt: Right on the beach in Nusa Dua, Bali

verified_facts.text: A lagoon pool meanders through the property.
verified_facts.excerpt: The expansive saltwater lagoon pool meanders through the property, providing a serene space for relaxation.

verified_facts.text: The one- and two-bedroom Lagoon Villas have direct access to the resort's lagoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: The one and two-bedroom Lagoon Villas offer an unparalleled luxury experience with direct access to the resort's expansive saltwater lagoon.

verified_facts.text: The one-bedroom Strand Villas have direct access to the white-sand beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: With direct access to the white-sand beach and the sparkling Indian Ocean, the one-bedroom Strand Villas offer the perfect setting for honeymooners and romantic getaways.

verified_facts.text: Each private villa has its own pool and a gazebo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience unparalleled living in the private villas at our Bali luxury resort, each thoughtfully designed with a serene pool and a picturesque gazebo.

verified_facts.text: The Strand Residence is a two-storey beachfront retreat with three or four bedrooms and direct beach access.
verified_facts.excerpt: This expansive two-storey retreat features three or four bedrooms, panoramic Indian Ocean vistas, and direct access to the beach.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Egyptian cotton bedding from Ploh.
verified_facts.excerpt: complemented by Egyptian cotton bedding from Ploh, premium toiletries, curated artwork, and our renowned St. Regis butler service

verified_facts.text: The resort offers 24-hour St. Regis Butler Service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Signature 24-hour St. Regis Butler Service

verified_facts.text: At The St. Regis Bar's evening ritual, a sommelier sabers Champagne with an Indonesian kris.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy live jazz and the evening ritual, where a sommelier sabers champagne with an Indonesian kris, creating an unforgettable atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: Dulang serves Balinese food in a carved gazebo, with drinks such as brem and kopi luwak.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in a carved gazebo, Dulang offers authentic Balinese dining with local ingredients, traditional flavors, and iconic drinks like brem and kopi luwak, capturing the essence of Balinese culture.

verified_facts.text: Kayuputi serves Pan-Asian beachfront dining facing the Indian Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set against the stunning Indian Ocean, Kayuputi offers exceptional Pan-Asian beachfront dining in Nusa Dua.

verified_facts.text: Boneka is inspired by Indonesia's puppet theater and serves Asian and international flavors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by Indonesia's puppet theater, Boneka restaurant in Bali, Nusa Dua, offers a diverse menu of Asian and international flavors

verified_facts.text: Breakfast at Boneka includes signature dishes such as Lobster Omelet and Wagyu Steak and Eggs.
verified_facts.excerpt: the celebrated breakfast at Boneka, featuring signature dishes such as Lobster Omelet and Wagyu Steak & Eggs

verified_facts.text: Vista Bar is a beachfront swim-up bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beachfront Vista Bar offers a serene swim-up retreat with handcrafted cocktails, refreshing beers, fine wines, and fresh coconuts

verified_facts.text: Rindik music plays in the lobby and a fire dance is performed at sunset by the Grand Staircase.
verified_facts.excerpt: from the gentle melodies of the rindik in the lobby to the captivating fire dance performance at sunset by the Grand Staircase

verified_facts.text: The resort opened on September 15, 2008.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since opening on September 15, 2008, The St. Regis Bali Resort, has garnered numerous prestigious awards

verified_facts.text: Iridium Spa includes private suites with outdoor bathtubs, hydrotherapy pools, aromatherapy steam rooms, a facial studio and a beauty salon.
verified_facts.excerpt: including private suites with outdoor bathtubs, hydrotherapy pools, aromatherapy steam rooms, a facial studio, and a full-service beauty salon

verified_facts.text: Iridium Spa treatments draw on traditional Indonesian healing rituals with European, Thai and Ayurvedic influences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by traditional Indonesian healing rituals and complemented by European, Thai, and Ayurvedic philosophies

verified_facts.text: Iridium Spa offers a Bloody Mary-inspired wellness ritual based on the signature St. Regis cocktail.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the signature St. Regis Bloody Mary cocktail, this 150-minute ritual transforms the ingredients of the iconic libation into a distinctive wellness experience.

verified_facts.text: Guests can snorkel with a guide at the resort's cultivated reef.
verified_facts.excerpt: Through guided snorkeling sessions at the resort’s cultivated reef, guests can encounter thriving corals and marine life

verified_facts.text: Guests can plant coral to help the reef grow.
verified_facts.excerpt: coral planting allows guests to contribute to the reef’s continued growth

verified_facts.text: Coral Discovery is available year-round, subject to weather conditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Available year-round, subject to weather conditions.

verified_facts.text: Yoga is held daily at Bale Pantai, a beachside pavilion overlooking the ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Held daily at Bale Pantai, a beachside pavilion overlooking the ocean

verified_facts.text: The Children's Club offers activities including art, music, cooking, yoga and conservation programs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club offers a range of engaging activities, including art, music, cooking, yoga, and conservation programs

verified_facts.text: Children can have a Tiny Afternoon Tea set up in a teepee tent in the villa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Delight in a whimsical Tiny Afternoon Tea, set up in an enchanting teepee tent right in the comfort of your villa.

verified_facts.text: Wedding venues include the Cloud Nine Chapel, the white sand beach and a private amphitheatre.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our incomparable venues include the stunning Cloud Nine Chapel, the pristine white sand beach, and a private amphitheatre

verified_facts.text: The resort built its own water filtration and bottling plant.
verified_facts.excerpt: initiatives including eliminating single-use plastics, building our own water filtration and bottling plant

verified_facts.text: For festive season bookings at The Strand Residence, guests should contact the reservations team.
verified_facts.excerpt: For festive season bookings, please contact our reservations team.

verified_facts.text: Nusa Dua is in the southeast of Bali.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the beach resort mecca of Nusa Dua, in the southeast of Bali
